Decorate

/DEK-uh-rayt/ · verb

Hear It

What It Means

Decorate means to make something more attractive by adding ornamental details or decorations to it

Every December, the Alvarez family spent an entire weekend decorating their porch with lights, wreaths, and a hand-painted wooden sleigh.

Worked Example

Before the gallery opening, volunteers spent three days decorating the empty warehouse with string lights, potted ferns, and dozens of borrowed antique mirrors, transforming a bare concrete space into something that looked worth a hundred-dollar ticket.

The warehouse's structure never changed — only its surface was transformed with added visual touches, which is exactly what "decorate" means.

How Decorate Sits Among Its Neighbors

Synonyms — open each to see how it differs

adorn

adorn: a more elevated, often literary word for the same act

embellish

embellish: stresses adding extra, sometimes unnecessary, decorative detail

trim

trim: a more casual word, often for adding decorative edges or accents

Antonyms

strip

strip: to remove decoration or covering entirely

bare

bare: as a verb, to leave something plain and undecorated

How Strong Is It? — trim → decorate → embellish

trim vs. decorate

trim vs. decorate: To trim a room might mean adding a single string of lights along one shelf.

embellish vs. decorate

embellish vs. decorate: To embellish a room means adding several decorative touches throughout, going beyond the basics.

Build the Word

The pieces

Root — decor-

Root — decor-: beauty, grace, that which is fitting (Latin decus/decor-)

Suffix — -ate

Suffix — -ate: verb-forming

Put it together

Put it together: "Decorate" comes from the Latin decor-, "beauty" or "fittingness" — to decorate something is literally to make it fitting and beautiful.

Use the root in a new word: decorum

Use the root in a new word: decorum: Even at the wildest party, the host insisted on a certain decorum, asking guests to at least use coasters.

Root Check

Word Choice

neutral, everyday

Decorate is a common, neutral verb used for anything from hanging holiday lights to designing an entire interior. It simply describes the act of adding visual appeal, without judging whether the result is tasteful or excessive.
